points.description: Names at least two valid distinguishing features from the model answer, such as edge detection/road edges, road width, or color of the road.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only one valid feature is given or the features are stated vaguely.

points.description: Names further valid features from the model answer, such as road length (between junctions or dead ends), or road edges/shadows used to identify bridges and flyovers. At least two of these features are needed across P1 and P2 combined, with one additional feature here.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if a further feature is only vaguely stated, for example 'length' with no context.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for listing about four valid features from the model answer (edges, width, length between junctions or dead ends, colour, edges/shadows for bridges and flyovers). Give part marks when only some valid features are listed or the features are vague. Give no marks for unrelated features, such as rainfall or soil type. Accept clear synonyms.
